data.title: Chat: harden the AS-74 roster-title cascade guard — all: unset, native CSS nesting, orgNodeItem class set

data.body: Filed from the AS-74 review (Priya, M6 probes past the plan's list; none blocks AS-74 — all three are constructs style.css/app.js do not use today). Scope, three one-line-ish hardenings: (1) test/roster-truncation.test.js CONTRACT table has no 'all' row — appending '.roster-title { all: unset; }' resets white-space/overflow/text-overflow in a browser and T1 stays green (probe P6 survived, 6/0). Fix: ['all', [null]]. (2) The cascade parser silently mis-reads native CSS nesting: '#roster-list { .roster-title { white-space: normal; } }' appended — inner rule is swallowed by parseDecls as a garbage declaration, T1 green (P7 survived). Fix: throw in parseDecls/parseBlocks when a style-rule body contains '{', the same loud-failure choice the helper makes for :is/:where/:not/:has. (3) orgNodeItem has no complete-class-set pin (plan §10 offer): 'el("span", "org-extra")' inserted before the meta el() call reds nothing (P10 survived, api.test.js 62/0). Fix: a deepEqual class-set assertion over the orgNodeItem region using the AS-74 item-3 quote-agnostic regex. Predicted host count +0/+1; each fix gets its own named mutant (M4).

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 19; planning lane on Opus after a Fable 429 at spawn). All three of Priya's AS-74 probes reproduced on a scratch copy at the intended site (P6, P7 incl. the & form, P10); plan adopts her three fixes and adds one sibling pin (a classList.add set over orgNodeItem — row.classList.add('org-extra') survives the el()-only pin one line away), each with its own named mutant; AS-74's R1-R4 verified still red on the scratch. Orchestrator's call: the sibling pin stays (it has its own falsifier and closes a hole one line from the one being fixed). Base host 605/603/0/2 on aeeca77; predicted 606 host, 606/598/0/8 compose. Implementer Marcus (second pair of eyes on Lena's parser; Lena named on AS-109), reviewer Ruben (Priya filed the fixes). Branch feat/AS-112-cascade-guard-hardening linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-112 added.

Implementation complete on feat/AS-112-cascade-guard-hardening, commit 9d70ae6 (test-only: apps/chat/test/roster-truncation.test.js +39/-2, apps/chat/test/api.test.js +18; diff --stat master...branch names only those two files). Plan §1 applied as written: (1) CONTRACT gains ['all', [null]] and T1's null case renders 'undeclared' instead of 'unset' in both the by-string and the allowed list; (2) walk() throws 'cannot score nested style rule (native CSS nesting) under: <prelude>' when a style-rule body contains '{', placed after the UNSCORABLE throw and before parseDecls; new helper case H6 under exactly the §1.2 name, with (a) descendant, (b) '&' and (c) inside-@media nesting plus the intact @keyframes ignore path; (3) T2 gains the deepEqual el() class-set pin ['org-node-meta','org-node-name','org-node-row','org-tree'] and (3b) the classList.add sibling pin ['org-root'], both scoped to the orgNodeItem region.

CARDINALITY. Host baseline on the untouched worktree (master b4e1a80 code): 605/603/0/2, matching master's record — no re-baseline needed. After the edits: roster-truncation alone 7/7, api alone 63/63, full host suite 606/604/0/2 (base + H6, AC-1). Mutant battery: 10 mutants + 1 helper flip = 11 runs on a detached scratch worktree /tmp/AS-112-mutant at 9d70ae6 (green at 606 before the first mutant); whole suite per run; applied-check asserted at the intended site before each run (occurrence counts, region-scoped to orgNodeItem for app.js); restore by git checkout proven by empty porcelain and a post-restore run at 606/604/0/2 after every mutant.

OBSERVED RED SETS (each exactly one test red in 606 unless stated): M1 {T1} '.roster-title all: effective value is unset — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 210); the contract allows undeclared' (211 rules parsed, 3 target); AS-32 CSS case green. M2 {T1} thrown 'cannot score nested style rule (native CSS nesting) under: #roster-list'; H6 green. M2b {T1} '…under: .roster-title'; H6 green. M3 {T2} 'orgNodeItem builds exactly these classes via el() — a missing one and a stray extra one both fail'; AS-32 rosterRow case green. M3b (single-quoted stray) {T2}, same message. M4 {T2} 'orgNodeItem adds exactly one class by classList — the board root marker'. R1 {T1} 'white-space: effective value is normal — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 210)'. R2 {T1} 'won by #roster-list .roster-title (spec 1,1,0, order 50)'. R3 {T2} on the meta-line literal pin. R4 {AS-32 el() case} only — T2 GREEN, so the new pin is region-scoped as claimed. H6 flip (assert.throws -> assert.doesNotThrow on line a): T1 file alone 7/6/1, exactly {H6}, 'Got unwanted exception.' Deviations from the plan's §2 table: none. Survivors: none.
